feed.title: WinNewsReader News
feed.subtitle: What's new in WinNewsReader, a feed reader for Windows in the spirit of NetNewsWire.

entry.title: WinNewsReader 1.0.0
entry.summary: WinNewsReader 1.0.0 is the first release: a native Windows port of NetNewsWire that reads RSS, Atom, JSON Feed and RSS-in-JSON, uses NetNewsWire's article themes, and keeps your feeds on your PC or syncs them with FreshRSS, Feedbin, NewsBlur, The Old Reader and BazQux (File → Add Account…). It has Find in Article (Ctrl+F), undo for marking read or starred and deleting a feed or folder, a taskbar unread badge and feed site icons. The window offers a mail-style column layout with the table across the top, sorting by feed, title, unread and starred, Group by Feed, a search scope button, and a status bar with a selection menu, a theme menu and click-to-cycle counts. Current Activity, Activity Log, Error Log, Account Stats and Dinosaurs windows are on Ctrl+6 to Ctrl+9, and you can drag links onto the sidebar to subscribe. The installer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen warns when you install.
